introHtml: Moisture wicking jackets pull sweat away from the skin to keep wearers dry and comfortable during physical activity or outdoor work. Unlike standard jackets that trap heat and moisture, these performance fabrics are engineered for breathability and quick drying. Marketing directors and safety managers often choose them for event staff, field crews, or giveaway programs where recipients will be active. Decorate with screen-printed logos or embroidered names for a professional finish that stays visible even after repeated washes.
